description: Transfer all solid solutes and exclude hollow magenta inhibitors. Move the selective pumps along the membrane and fire an ATP stroke for the incoming solutes. Each stroke spends one of four ATP, locks the selected height, extends for 0.4 seconds and opens briefly. Steering during a stroke queues the next height. The stroke cannot be cancelled. The pumps take time to move; particles keep flowing while you hold a pump. One lost solute or admitted inhibitor ends the attempt. Inspect the chamber, then start perfusion. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs. Only task-created tabs and their visible controls are allowed.
